title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct, documented Smith College library study environments in Northampton.

cards.title: Neilson 302 Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Neilson Library, third floor
cards.notes: Bring reading or writing that benefits from a dedicated reading-room setting; the library lists this room among individual and large-table study options.
cards.short_summary: A named third-floor reading room with individual and group-study furnishings.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Libraries lists Neilson 302 Reading Room as an individual study space and among locations with large study tables.
cards.access_notes: Most study spaces on the Libraries page are first-come, first-served; check current Neilson Library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Neilson 401 Skyline Reading Room and Terrace
cards.title: Neilson 401 Skyline Reading Room and Terrace
cards.subtitle: Neilson Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Set up at the reading-room tables, then use the terrace only when it is open; Smith notes seasonal and evening terrace closures.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor reading room paired with a seasonal outdoor terrace.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Libraries identifies the fourth-floor Skyline Reading Room and Terrace as both an individual study space and a large-table study location.
cards.access_notes: The terrace closes at 6 p.m. during warm weather and is closed over winter; library hours apply.

cards.title: Neilson 015 Ground Floor Stacks Carrels
cards.subtitle: Neilson Library, ground floor
cards.notes: Choose a carrel for quiet individual work and keep conversation brief; it is one of the library’s designated quiet-study locations.
cards.short_summary: Quiet carrels located in Neilson’s ground-floor stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Libraries designates the ground-floor stacks carrels in Neilson 015 as a quiet study space.
cards.access_notes: Designated quiet study; individual library carrels generally cannot be reserved.

cards.title: Neilson 210 North Wing Study Area
cards.subtitle: Neilson Library, second-floor north wing
cards.notes: Use this designated quiet area for concentrated reading or laptop work; select a carrel or table and keep sound low.
cards.short_summary: A quiet second-floor north-wing study area with carrels and tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Libraries lists Neilson 210, the second-floor north-wing study area, as a quiet study space.
cards.access_notes: Designated quiet study; check Neilson Library’s current open hours before going.

cards.title: Neilson 310 North Wing Study Area
cards.subtitle: Neilson Library, third-floor north wing
cards.notes: Head upstairs for a designated quiet-study area with a choice of study carrels and larger tables for independent work.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor quiet-study area with carrels and larger worktables.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Libraries lists Neilson 310, the third-floor north-wing study area, as quiet study and as a location with large study tables.
cards.access_notes: Designated quiet study; individual library carrels generally cannot be reserved.

cards.title: Neilson 102 Browsing Room
cards.subtitle: Neilson Library, first floor
cards.notes: Use the large tables for a shared work session, and confirm the room is not assigned before relying on it for a longer block.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor browsing room documented with large study tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Libraries lists Neilson 102 Browsing Room among locations with large study tables and identifies it as a Neilson Library space.
cards.access_notes: The room is also used for teaching and events; contact the Registrar’s Office for scheduled use.

cards.title: Neilson 108 Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Neilson Library, first floor
cards.notes: Pair your study session with scheduled peer support, workshops, or a study group; tutors and partner programs work from this student-centered space.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor collaborative learning space with peer academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith identifies the Learning Commons in Neilson 108 as a student-centered space for collaborative learning, tutoring, workshops, and study groups.
cards.access_notes: Open during all Neilson Library open hours; tutoring and programs occur throughout the semester.

cards.title: Hillyer Art Library Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Hillyer Art Library
cards.notes: Use the second floor when you need a designated quiet setting, especially for reading, writing, or reviewing visual-arts materials.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study floor within Smith’s art library.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Libraries lists the second floor of Hillyer Art Library as a quiet study space.
cards.access_notes: Hillyer has variable noise levels outside its listed quiet-study area; check current library hours.

cards.title: Josten J133 Listening Room
cards.subtitle: Josten Performing Arts Library
cards.notes: For a small shared work session, use the room when it is not otherwise in use; check with Josten staff if you need to reserve it.
cards.short_summary: A performing-arts library listening room with large tables when unbooked.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Libraries lists Josten J133 Listening Room as a large-table group-study location when it is not otherwise in use.
cards.access_notes: Open for use when not reserved; contact Josten Library for reservation details and current access.

cards.entity_name: Alumnae Gymnasium Third Floor Study Area
cards.title: Alumnae Gymnasium Third Floor Study Area
cards.subtitle: Alumnae Gymnasium, third floor
cards.notes: Use the third-floor soft seating and large tables for individual or group work; bring your Smith OneCard for round-the-clock swipe access.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study area with soft seating and large tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Libraries lists the Alumnae Gymnasium third floor for soft seating and large-table study, and states that Alumnae Gymnasium is open 24 hours for study.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours for study; Smith Libraries describes the building as having 24-hour swipe access.
